note: The angles, times, plane, rotation, elbow and suggested muscles below are TEST VALUES for checking the animation. They are typical textbook-style numbers, not researched and not checked by a clinician. No citation belongs to them. The animation never goes past the stated allowed range. Urdu and Roman Urdu are machine-written and need a native speaker's review.
conventions: elevation: angle of the upper arm from the model's rest pose, positive = up, negative = backward. plane: direction of elevation, 0 = side, 90 = forward, 30 = scapular plane. rotation: about the long axis of the upper arm, positive = external. elbow: flexion, 0 = straight. t: fraction of the loop. Hold = two frames with equal values.

instruction.en: Slowly lift your arm out to the side, then lower it.
instruction.ur: آہستہ سے اپنا بازو پہلو کی طرف اٹھائیں، پھر نیچے لائیں۔
instruction.roman: Aahista se apna bazu pehlu ki taraf uthayein, phir neeche layein.

caution.en: Move only as far as comfortable. Stop if pain is sharp or severe.
caution.ur: صرف اتنا حرکت کریں جتنا آرام دہ ہو۔ شدید یا تیز درد ہو تو رک جائیں۔
caution.roman: Sirf itna hilayein jitna araam deh ho. Tez ya shadeed dard ho to ruk jayein.

instruction.en: Keep your elbow at your side, bent like the letter L. Gently push your hand outward against something steady, like a door frame.
instruction.ur: کہنی کو پہلو کے ساتھ رکھیں اور L کی شکل میں موڑیں۔ ہاتھ کو کسی مضبوط چیز، جیسے دروازے کی چوکھٹ، کے خلاف آہستہ سے باہر کی طرف دبائیں۔
instruction.roman: Kuhni ko pehlu ke sath rakhein aur L ki shakal mein modein. Haath ko kisi mazboot cheez, jaise darwaze ki chaukhat, ke khilaf aahista se bahar ki taraf dabayein.
